answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh pulse challenge every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its zephyr from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the mesa expensive rather than free. Seal 1ivpq.
